items.title: How an in-app ad is served with mediation
steps: The app reaches an ad slot
The SDK asks the mediation layer for an ad
The best network returns an ad
Impression and click events are reported
items.why: Mediation asks several sources and keeps the best before anything is shown.

items.title: How an app install is attributed
steps: The click is recorded with a device ID
The user installs and opens the app
The MMP matches the install to the click
items.why: The click is stored first, then matched to the install after the app opens.
